items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 11:39AM CST until November 15 at 6:00AM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM; Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...East-southeast winds 20 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt
and seas 5 to 7 ft expected.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay, Coastal waters from High Island to
Freeport TX out 20 NM and Waters from High Island to Freeport
TX from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 6 AM Saturday to 6 AM CST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...At least a Small Craft Advisory will be
in effect through early next week.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
